body:
build.rs still rebuilds only the board bundle. frontend/priv/app.js is checked in, so include_bytes! compiles. When the frontend source changes, someone has to rebuild that bundle by hand. Rebuilding it from build.rs would need the frontend's solace.toml

Add a new build & bundle command in frontend, consistent with the one in the board project.
Then have the main solace project refer to that command when building.
title: Add command to build
